title: skills(objectstack-automation): teach that a retried outbound call inside a subflow or map body under an after-record-change trigger is registered but never armed
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (a follow-up recommended by the at-tier contract review 6886689695 of PR #33482, card #32525).

PR #33482 teaches that an `after-record-change` flow's retry may not reach an inline outbound `http` or `connector_action` node, in the `try_catch`, `http` and `connector_action` rows. It does not teach the other half: an outbound node reached through a `subflow` or a `map` body under the same retry is registered but not armed (`unboundCause: retried_callout_in_subflow`). That half fails silently, so it is the one an author most needs a sentence for.

**What lands.** One sentence in `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` (or the flows reference it owns) naming the silent half and its remedy, checked against the engine's walk on `main`. Also correct the pre-existing "`errorHandling.retry`" wording near line 155 to the real spelling. `@objectstack/skills` patch. Token ratchet paid in place.

Blocked-by: #32525 (PR #33482)
